query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS managed_url(id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, host TEXT NOT NULL, path TEXT NOT NULL, deployment_id TEXT NOT NULL, port INTEGER NOT NULL,  CONSTRAINT managed_url_chk_port_range CHECK(port > 0 AND port <= 65535), CONSTRAINT managed_url_chk_host_nonempty CHECK(LENGTH(TRIM(host)) > 0),  FOREIGN KEY(deployment_id) REFERENCES deployment(id));
